**Finding: Compliant (preferred position).**

Section 9.4 plus Section 29.4 gives us a 30-day convenience termination right across the Agreement and any Order Form, with liability capped at accrued Fees and a refund of prepaid Fees (echoed in Section 10). No early-termination fee or penalty appears anywhere, and Vendor's termination rights are confined to material breach (9.1) and insolvency (9.2) — no Vendor convenience right mid-term. No redline required.
